title: 优化的边界：目标函数、搜索空间与六核心的停止规则 / The Boundary of Optimization: Objective Functions, Search Spaces and Stopping Rules
description:
中文摘要。「优化」听起来像方法，实际上是一个四前提结构：目标函数、搜索空间、预算与时钟、停止规则。缺任一项，优化就变成另一种东西——指标失真、锁定、无限投入或反噬。

背景与问题。本件是《有限系统的取舍》系列第 16 件，接在《被点燃的生态》之后，处理「优化的边界」这一支：把母题落到一类可核对的材料上。

方法与结构。全文 14 节，附录不超过 6 件。

主要结果。

贡献。本件的贡献有三：把「优化的边界」写成可检验的条件；给出可复算的读数或结构；公开边界、失败与撤回。

边界。见正文各章末与附录登记簿。

版本信息。2026-11-14，64 页；全文 14 节，附录不超过 6 件。内容 CC BY 4.0；概念 DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23611781 。

Abstract.Optimization is a four-premise structure. Twenty cases of overreach are coded; target overreach is most common, stopping-rule overreach most severe, budget overreach least recorded. Evolution serves as the counter-example.

Background.This is item 16 of the series, following 被点燃的生态; it tests the series motif on the material named in the title.

Method and structure.14 sections, at most six appendices.

Results.The paper reports its readings with explicit failure conditions; the Abstract lists the headline numbers.

Contributions.It contributes three things: it states the problem as checkable conditions; gives reproducible readings or structures; and publishes its boundaries, failures and retractions.

Boundaries.See chapter ends and the register appendices; conclusion strength never exceeds evidence strength.

Edition.2026-11-14, 64 pages; 14 sections, at most six appendices. Content CC BY 4.0; concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23611781 .
